description: This file contains the implementation of a generic wrapper class for transactional state storage in Orleans, including methods for loading and storing state, as well as the definition of a serializable record class for transactional state data.

classes.name: TransactionalStateStorageProviderWrapper<TState>
classes.description: A wrapper class implementing ITransactionalStateStorage for managing transactional state in Orleans, providing load and store functionalities with concurrency control.

classes.name: TransactionalStateRecord<TState>
classes.description: A serializable record class that holds the committed state, sequence ID, metadata, and pending states for a transactional state.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the current transactional state, returning a response containing the state data and metadata.

methods.name: Store
methods.description: Asynchronously stores the provided state, handling concurrency via ETag, and manages pending, committed, and aborted transactions.

methods.name: GetStateStorage
methods.description: Creates and returns a new StateStorageBridge instance for the given state name, context, and grain storage.
